title: Pricing | Kimchi.dev
markdown:
# Flexible pricing for every team Choose the plan that fits your usage. ### Coder For individual developers who want full access. $20/mo [Get Kimchi](https://app.kimchi.dev/) - Everything in Open source, plus: - Includes $25 monthly credits - **Priority request speed** - **1M context window** - Max 3 seats - Max 1 team - Inference API for OSS and open-weight models - Email support - Cost per token is [here](https://docs.kimchi.dev/docs/model-apis-pricing). [More details](https://kimchi.dev/pricing#pricing-table) ### Teams For teams collaborating and shipping together. $35/seat /mo [Book a call](https://kimchi.dev/book-a-call) - Everything in Coder, plus: - Includes $45 monthly credits - **Priority request speed** - **1M context window** - Max 150 seats - Unlimited teams - Kimchi Studio - Team budget monitoring and RBAC - Cloud marketplace billing - Cost per token is [here](https://docs.kimchi.dev/docs/model-apis-pricing). [More details](https://kimchi.dev/pricing#pricing-table) ### Enterprise For orgs optimizing AI coding infrastructure at scale. Custom [Book a call](https://kimchi.dev/book-a-call) - Custom, per-use pricing and volume discounts - **Enterprise request speed** - **1M context window** - Unlimited seats - Unlimited teams - Self-hosted deployment option in your VPC, with full data sovereignty - White-glove onboarding - 24×7 dedicated success manager [More details](https://kimchi.dev/pricing#pricing-table) ### Code Review AI-powered pull-request review, available as an add-on. Inline findings with severity, a summary and score on every PR - your rules, your model, your budget. - GitHub and GitLab: 1-click install - Re-reviews on every push - Model choice per repo - Per-repo instructions and excluded paths - Findings count against your budget caps - Every event stored for audit $25/user /mo [Request Access](https://kimchi.dev/contact) Unlimited Repos ### Workspaces Governed cloud workspaces for your team's agents, available as an add-on. An admin defines the template once - compute, tools, network policy - and the policy arrives with every workspace. - Templates set compute, tools and network policy - Credentials injected by the gateway, never on disk - Web IDE, VS Code and SSH access - Sessions keep running when you close the laptop - Idle workspaces hibernate after 24 hours - Audit log and per-user quotas $0.1027/vCPU /hour [Request Access](https://kimchi.dev/contact) Billed per vCPU-hour ### Open source Security, compliance, and control aren't afterthoughts. Every feature ships enterprise-ready. Which models can I run with Kimchi? Kimchi Coding stacks the strongest open source and open‑weight models. Can I switch plans anytime? Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time, and changes apply right away. What payment methods do you accept? We accept major credit cards and integrate with all major cloud provider marketplaces. Enterprise customers can request invoicing. Do you have any special offers for startups? Eligible companies can join our Startup Program. Reach out and we'll help you get set up. How does the Open Source plan work? You download Kimchi Coding and run it on your own machine or infrastructure. Bring your own inference - Kimchi's managed API, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or any LLM provider. No hosted inference, no rate limits imposed by us.
